title: dendranthema yoshinaganthum
intro: Dendranthema yoshinaganthum, commonly known as Chrysanthemum yoshinaganthum, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Dendranthema yoshinaganthum include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, which may help to alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
